jobs.title: Sr Change Management Consultant
jobs.description:
IQVIA
With approximately 90,000 employees in more than 100 countries, IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services for the healthcare industry. IQVIA Healthcare Consulting Services supports healthcare organizations in driving innovation, operational excellence and sustainable transformation, helping clients improve outcomes for patients and healthcare professionals.

Role
IQVIA is looking for a Senior Consultant, Change Management to support the successful implementation and adoption of large-scale digital transformation initiatives within public healthcare organizations in the Valencian Community.
The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing change management processes, communication, stakeholder engagement and training strategies to facilitate organizational adoption and ensure project objectives are achieved. This role requires strong consulting capabilities, healthcare sector expertise and experience managing organizational changes in complex healthcare environments.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead change management workstreams within complex healthcare transformation projects.
- Assess organizational readiness and identify issues across stakeholders and user groups.
- Develop and implement communication, engagement and adoption strategies.
- Design and deliver training programs and educational materials for healthcare professionals and end users.
- Conduct workshops, interviews and stakeholder analysis activities.
- Support organizational transition planning and adoption monitoring.
- Develop documentation, reports, presentations and project deliverables.
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure alignment between business, operational and technical objectives.
- Monitor project milestones and proactively identify risks related to user adoption and organizational change.
- Build strong client relationships and contribute to business development opportunities.

Requirements:
- MECES Level 2 academic qualification (Bachelor's Degree, Engineering Degree, Licentiate Degree or equivalent).
- Minimum of 5 years of relevant consulting experience.
- Experience supporting implementation and adoption of healthcare technology solutions.
- Teaching Certificate (CAP) or equivalent pedagogical qualification.
- Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
- Experience facilitating workshops, training sessions and organizational change initiatives.
- Experience in Electronic Health Record (EHR) implementations, either as part of the functional team or through Change Management activities.
- Experience in the localization of technology solutions and related supporting materials.
- Experience facilitating workshops, training sessions and organizational change initiatives.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex project environment.
- Excellent presentation, reporting and client-facing skills.
- Native Spanish and professional English.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master's Degree in Business Administration, Health Management or related field.
- Formal Change Management certification (Prosci, APMG, ACMP or equivalent).
- Project Management certification (PMP, Prince2 or equivalent).
- Experience working with public healthcare organizations.
- Knowledge of healthcare processes and clinical workflows.

Location:
Valencia, Spain, Hybrid Formula

jobs.title: Management Consultant - Healthcare/Life sciences
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a talented individual to join our Consulting team covering North, East, and West Africa and thrive in a client-focused environment. This opportunity is ideal for professionals who want to deepen their understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, contribute to a wide range of consulting engagements, and apply their analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex client needs.
As a Consultant , you will contribute to the development and delivery of management consulting projects for our pharmaceutical and life sciences clients. Our clients rely on our knowledge, experience, and problem-solving capabilities to optimize strategies across their organizations. Our ability to leverage and analyze data, combined with our in-depth understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and healthcare systems, enables us to deliver high-quality insights addressing a variety of client needs.
Job Overview
Responsible for the timely completion of assigned project activities or components of larger Management Consulting projects for clients in the life sciences sector. Contributes to the development of client deliverables, conducts qualitative and quantitative analyses, and supports project teams in addressing client needs.
Essential Functions
- Participates in the design, development, and delivery of Management Consulting projects or specific components of larger, complex engagements.
- Reviews and analyzes client requirements or business challenges and contributes to the development of relevant and cost-effective solutions.
- Conducts qualitative and quantitative analyses to support the identification of client issues and the development of client-specific recommendations.
- Collects, structures, validates, and analyzes data from multiple sources.
- Develops detailed and high-quality project deliverables, reports, proposals, and presentations.
- Structures and prepares client presentations tailored to the characteristics and needs of the audience.
- Presents selected analyses, insights, or findings during internal and client meetings.
- Contributes to the development of recommendations and alternative solutions to address client challenges.
- Supports project planning, monitors assigned activities, and ensures that deliverables are completed on time and according to quality standards.
- Collaborates effectively with project team members across functions and geographies.
- Provides guidance and support to Analysts assigned to the engagement, where appropriate.
- Supports day-to-day communication with clients and internal stakeholders.
- Contributes to proposal development and other business-development activities.
- May help identify potential follow-on work or new opportunities based on client needs observed during project delivery.
- Proactively develops broader and deeper knowledge of consulting methodologies, healthcare systems, and life sciences markets through project experience and training opportunities.
- Begins to develop expertise in selected therapeutic areas, markets, or consulting capabilities.

Qualifications
- Degree in Pharmacy or Medicine, or a Master’s degree, preferably in Economics, Business, Engineering, Public Health, or another relevant discipline from a leading university or school.
- 4 to 5 years of relevant experience in management consulting, the pharmaceutical industry, healthcare, or life sciences.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
- Good project-management and organizational capabilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.
- Good understanding of consulting methodologies, tools, and techniques.
- Knowledge of key issues and current developments in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences industry.
- Ability to conduct qualitative and quantitative analyses and translate findings into actionable insights.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong presentation skills and the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams and clients.
- Ability to develop productive working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
- Works willingly and effectively with others across the organization to accomplish team goals.
- Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.
- Fluency in English and French is preferred.
- International or cross-geography experience is a plus.

What Can You Expect to Get in Return?
Talented individuals joining our team will gain deep knowledge of healthcare and pharmaceutical industry consulting, benefit from a rapid learning curve, and have opportunities to work on diverse assignments across geographies.
We offer a flexible working environment, including flexible working hours and the possibility of working from home.
Our IQVIA Consulting team offers a unique combination of management consulting, healthcare expertise, and data analytics. Our end-to-end solutions include market-entry strategy, portfolio and pricing optimization, market-access studies, and commercial-model design.
We are a young and fast-growing Management Consulting team covering North, East, and West Africa. Come and join us!
Sounds promising? Let us know, and we will help you take your first steps with IQVIA. If this particular position does not match your profile, we have other opportunities available that may be of interest.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant / Manager～Associate Principal(Management Consulting)
jobs.description:
【ポジション名】
Senior Consultant / Manager～Associate Principal(Management Consulting)

【会社紹介・ビジョン】
私たちIQVIAは、ヒューマンデータサイエンスの先駆的な企業として、医療・ヘルスケアの前進に取り組む皆様をIQVIAならではの革新的なソリューションによってご支援することで、「誰もが、より健康に自分らしく生きられる社会」の実現を目指しています。
世界最大規模を誇る医療・ヘルスケア関連データを基盤に、人・データ・サイエンスを融合させた見地から、未だ満たされない治療ニーズに応える、新たな医薬品や医療機器の開発と市販化、厳格化する規制やコンプライアンスへの対応、持続可能な医療システム推進の支援など、患者さんをはじめとするすべての人々のために、より良い未来へと医療・ヘルスケアを前進させていく力となることが、私たちの使命です。
世界100以上の国と地域で約9万人が活動するIQVIAの日本法人として、IQVIAジャパンでは約6,000人が一丸となり、この使命に向かって日々、力を尽くしています。

【部署・チーム名】
Management Consulting（コンサルティング部門）

【所属部署・チーム概要】
Management Consultingは、IQVIAの戦略コンサルティング部門として、 ヘルスケア・ライフサイエンス業界の変革テーマを専門に扱うチーム です。
- クライアント ：製薬企業を中心に、医療機器メーカー、コンシューマーヘルス企業、投資ファンドなど多岐にわたる
- 対応領域 ： - 革新的新薬の研究開発からコマーシャライゼーションまでの各フェーズにおける戦略立案
- 組織最適化、営業改革、業務プロセス改善
- AI含むソリューション構想策定・実装
- 全社戦略、成長戦略、事業ポートフォリオ戦略、M&A/LA、海外進出/日本参入戦略
- 社内テクノロジーチームとの協業によるデジタルテーマ（業務改革の構想・実装）

- 強み ：ライフサイエンス領域における深い専門性を有し、IQVIA国内外のデータプラットフォーム・デジタルアセット・専門人材を活用しながらクライアントの課題解決を支援

【チームの雰囲気】
- コンサルファーム、ITベンダー、投資ファンド、製薬企業、医療機関など多様なバックグラウンドのメンバーで構成
- オープンでニュートラルな雰囲気で、専門性を活かした議論が活発
- グローバルプロジェクトも複数常時進行しており、世界レベルでの課題感やベストプラクティスを共有できる環境
- 新薬・デジタルヘルスなど新しいテーマが多く、常に新たな学びや成長機会が豊富
- 挑戦を歓迎し、成長を重視するカルチャー

【ポジション概要・チームが目指すゴール】
本ポジションは、ライフサイエンス領域の戦略プロジェクトの中心人物として、クライアントの最重要課題を解決するための付加価値の高いソリューションを構想・実行します。
APAC／グローバルチームと連携し、データ×戦略×テクノロジーを融合したコンサルティングを通じて、医療・ヘルスケア産業の変革をリードすることが求められます。

【主な業務内容】
- クライアントの課題解決に向けたコンサルティングプロジェクトの企画・提案・推進
- 戦略テーマ（ブランド戦略、ローンチ戦略、NPP、デジタル戦略、営業組織改革等）のリード
- クライアント向けレポート・提案資料の作成および高品質なデリバリー
- 新規ビジネス機会の創出（フォローオン案件、追加提案など）
- 若手メンバーの育成・プロジェクトマネジメント
- 業界動向を踏まえたインサイト提供
- 社内外のステークホルダーとの連携・協業

【役割への期待】
- 若手メンバーをリードし、Project Managerとして高い品質でDeliveryする
- 論理的思考力と分析力を発揮してクライアント価値を最大化する
- 経営層との議論が可能なコミュニケーション能力を持つ
- ビジネス拡大に寄与する新規提案・機会創出への積極的な関与
- チーム全体の成長に資するリーダーシップ

【求める人物像】（必須要件）
- コンサルティング会社または事業会社での戦略/企画/業務改善等の経験
- ライフサイエンス・ヘルスケア領域への強い興味や経験
- 仮説構築力・論理的思考力・課題解決能力
- CEO/COO/CMOクラスを含む多様なステークホルダーと対話できる力
- プロジェクト推進力、チームワーク、若手育成への意欲
- 日本語必須、英語ビジネスレベル歓迎

【歓迎要件】
- 製薬企業でのマーケティング／NPP／デジタル関連の経験
- マーケットアクセス、患者中心戦略の経験
- グローバル案件の経験
- Thought Leadership （講演・執筆等）
- データ分析・テクノロジーを用いたソリューション構築経験

【このポジションの魅力・キャリアパス】
- ポートフォリオ戦略〜事業性評価〜営業戦略など、さまざまな切り口から企業成長に貢献できる
- AI/デジタル、グローバルアセットを活用した高インパクトの創出が可能
- コンサルパートナーだけでなく、事業会社マネジメント、スタートアップ、PEファンドなど多様なキャリアパスが描ける
- 社会的インパクトの大きいヘルスケア産業の未来づくりに寄与できる

【勤務地】
東京（品川オフィス）／ハイブリッド勤務

【雇用形態・勤務時間・福利厚生・休日休暇】
- 雇用形態：正社員
- 勤務時間：9:00〜17:00
- フレックス勤務：あり
- 在宅勤務制度：あり
- 福利厚生：社会保険完備、IQVIA独自制度あり
- 受動喫煙対策：あり
- 休日休暇：年次有給休暇、夏季休暇、病気休暇、特別休暇、女性特別休暇、育児介護休暇、看護休暇など
- 試用期間：あり（通常6か月）

【給与・待遇】
- 当社規定により優遇
- 昇給：あり
- 賞与：あり
- 時間外手当：あり

【選考プロセス】
書類選考 → 1〜3次面接

【応募方法】
応募方法の詳細や連絡先については別途ご案内します。
あなたのストーリーを、ぜひ聞かせてください。

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Supply Chain & Operations, Management Consulting
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Consultant, Management Consulting that will be part of the Supply Chain & Operations division part of the Consulting unit in IQVIA Italy (Milan).
Collaborating closely with the Associate Principal of the practice, the Senior Consultant will be involved in
supply chain innovation projects at the strategic, tactical and operational levels, aimed at driving and supporting the transformation and growth of organizations across the Life Sciences industry.

Examples of projects include:
- End-to-end supply chain maturity assessment
- Redesign of supply chain management processes
- Implementation of digital solutions to support demand and supply planning
- Optimization of material flows, inventory levels, and manufacturing and logistics resources
- Distribution network review

Main responsibilities:
- Deliver high-quality, on-time deliverables to client projects in the life sciences field.
- Review and analyze client requirements to develop insightful, value-added proposals.
- Engage with clients and present complete, client-specific solutions and recommendations, frequently collaborating with other IQVIA teams (Analytics, Commercial Consulting, Real World, Market Research, etc.).
- Perform quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify client issues and perform desk research, leveraging IQVIA proprietary data assets.
- Maintain in-depth and consistently up-to-date knowledge of the client's strategies, business issues, and relationships, from senior management down to the operational levels.
- Contribute to the preparation, execution and follow-up of client workshops.
- Provide support to proposal development activities (provides support to Principals in proposal design/stream, finding of sources, etc.).
- Actively participate in clients’ meetings and visit clients’ plants – Italian territory mainly.
- Work independently and as part of a team, with responsibility for coordinating and supervising the work of more junior team members, providing them with direction and guidance.

Desired Qualifications and Experience:
- MSc degree in Engineering/Economics/Management with strong record of academic achievement.
- 5+ years' consulting work experience with a management consulting firm, with extensive expertise in transformation projects across Supply Chain and Operations (including experience in the Life Sciences industry).
- ASCM certifications (e.g., CPIM, CSCP, CLTD) are a plus.
- PMI certifications (e.g., CAPM, PMP) are a plus.

Personal & Technical Skills
- Proficiency both in Italian and in English (both written and spoken).
- Strong communication, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent execution skills, consistently meeting deadlines.
- Ability to work on a team.
- Ability to manage multiple projects, juggle priorities and deliver on tight deadlines.
- Keenness to learn and commitment to a rapid development curve.
- In-depth and long-standing relationships with client companies, especially at a senior level.
- Works willingly and effectively with others in and across the organization to accomplish team goals.
- Demonstrated strategic thinking and project and change management skills.
- Excellent interpersonal and networking skills.
- Willingness to travel.

Location: Milan, Italy (hybrid)

jobs.title: Engagement Manager, Healthcare Strategy Consulting
jobs.description:
아이큐비아는 제약·바이오 및 헬스케어 분야에서 압도적인 데이터 전문성을 기반으로 독보적인 입지를 구축한 글로벌 프로페셔널 서비스 기업입니다.
그 중 전략 컨설팅 부서는 국내·글로벌 제약사 및 바이오-테크, PE·VC, 헬스케어 사업을 영위하는 대기업 등을 대상으로 다양한 전략 프로젝트를 수행하고 있습니다.

Job Overview
Manages multiple consulting projects of varying complexity and ensures on-time and on-budget delivery for clients in the life sciences field. Contributes to new business development and maintaining and strengthening client base. May support the development of new offerings.

Essential Functions
• Manages project teams including both internal and external resources in the design, development and delivery of client solutions.
• Leads teams to review and analyze client requirements or challenges and develops associated proposals that ensure profitability and high client satisfaction with limited if any senior management input.
• Manages the process of proposal preparation and/or modifications including overall bid integrity.
• Develops project plan with timelines and deliverables and leads project to successful completion, on-time and on-budget, from start to finish with limited senior management guidance.
• Serves as key point of contact with client.
• Provides high level input to, and ensures the development of, client reports and presentations and delivers all or significant portions of findings to client.
• Develops and/or elevates new business opportunities through the identification of follow-on work and new leads.
• Proactively continues to strengthen subject matter expertise through on the job experience, participation in conferences and symposiums and other forums for professional knowledge sharing.
• Mentors, coaches and shares subject matter expertise with others to elevate our capabilities.

Qualifications
• 10+ years of experience in strategic consulting (experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare sectors preferred)
• Experience in strategic consulting and/or Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies
• Demonstrates excellent project management skills and client influencing and relationship building skills.
• In-depth understanding of IQVIA data assets and the IQVIA core offerings.
• Experienced with developing consultative relationships with senior level managers and executives at clients in the life sciences industry.
• Ability to manage multiple projects, juggle priorities and deliver on tight deadlines.
• Knowledge of key issues and current developments in the life sciences industry.

jobs.location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States of America
jobs.description:
Market Access represents one of the most critical barriers to patients accessing the therapies they need. Health insurers restrict patient access to therapies that carry less value for them, posing an obvious challenge to drug makers. The IQVIA Market Access Strategy Consulting team (formerly known as Amundsen Consulting), is a market-leading strategy and analytics division within IQVIA that helps manufacturers in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry meet the challenges of today’s patient access and affordability landscape. We create value for our clients by improving patient access to some of the most advanced pharmaceutical and biologic therapies, targeting challenging and complex healthcare needs of patients in the US.

Our team uses the power of healthcare data to help manufacturers measure the impact of market access on brand performance and the cascading influence this has on how prescribers and patients gain access to innovative therapies. We support manufacturers by providing deep insights into the geographic variations of patient, insurer, and prescriber behavior and thereby help manufacturers implement more effective strategies for sales execution, insurer contracting, net revenue optimization, and all varieties of patient assistance programs.

The Market Access Strategy Consulting team at IQVIA recruits individuals with degrees from some of the world’s top institutions. As a new hire, you will be provided on-the-job training that will allow you to develop the skills and business acumen necessary to successfully navigate the largest and most comprehensive set of US healthcare data assets. The knowledge and experience you build as an Associate will prepare you to generate high-quality insights and analytics for senior leaders at the top pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies in the US to address a wide variety of evolving business needs.

IQVIA, the Human Data Science Company™, possesses the largest and most comprehensive set of healthcare data assets in the world. Join us as we focus on using data, analytics and strategy to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.

Locations:  Boston, MA & San Francisco, CA

Start Date:  July 2027

Position Overview:

As a core member of the Market Access Strategy Consulting team, Associates are responsible for executing high-quality quantitative analytics to address a variety of distinct client business questions and needs. After receiving rigorous training, Associates will develop expertise across a number of analytical methodologies and tools that will be used to develop Market Access strategies for clients. They will begin their role under the guidance of more senior team members but are quickly provided with significant opportunities to contribute to all aspects of client engagements. Many Associates have the opportunity to present project materials to the client either via phone or at the client site early on in their tenure. In their second and third years with the practice, team members begin to assume an active managerial role running projects and mentoring more junior colleagues. IQVIA values collaboration and a flat structure - Associates work directly with senior leaders on project work, thought leadership activities, and in professional development.

Key Responsibilities:
- Execute high-quality, logical, and timely strategic analysis using a wide range of ‘big data” assets to derive trends, conclusions, and actionable recommendations for clients

- Conduct primary (qualitative) and secondary (quantitative) research on markets, payers, physicians, patients, and competitive products to identify key findings for client engagements

- Actively participate in internal brainstorming sessions, collaborate with project team, and exercise informed business judgement in identifying the best approach to address key client needs

- Develop sophisticated predictive models to inform contracting strategies, patient cost and affordability programs, prescriber / product utilization, and brand performance / financial modeling

- Translate analyses into thorough and insightful conclusions and outputs to address client issues and succinctly deliver these conclusions to clients via reports, presentations, and other tools

- Prepare for internal project team and client meetings to contribute and discuss analysis and answer questions on their work

- Leverage all available QC tools and demonstrates a knowledge of QC standards, applied consistently throughout the project in all aspects of the work

- Manage own time effectively and meet deadlines

- Manage upward by proactively communicating progress and challenges (context, assumptions, rationale and limitations in analyses) and request guidance when needed

- Develop deep knowledge of the healthcare industry and consulting methodologies

- Assist with recruiting new team members and participate in the interview process

An ideal candidate will have:

- A strong academic record (GPA 3.5/4 or greater), excellent problem-solving abilities, exceptional communication skills, strong quantitative skills, and be a proven team contributor

- Bachelors or Master’s Degree, preferable in the following areas (but not limited to) Biology, biochemistry, economics, finance, business, healthcare management and policy, history, molecular biology and genetics, psychology, neuroscience, public health and international relations

- An interest in and desire to learn about the constantly evolving healthcare industry

- Good project management, time management and organizational skills

- Excellent conversational and business English (written and oral)

- Exceptional IT literacy e.g. Word, PowerPoint, Excel (SQL is a plus)

- A willingness to travel as needed (

jobs.title: Director, Mergers & Acquisitions Integration
jobs.description:
Integration Project Manager

ROLE SUMMARY
The Integration Project Manager leads the planning and execution of acquisition integrations, ensuring a successful transition from due diligence through to steady-state operations. The IPM owns the overall integration plan, coordinates cross-functional workstreams, drives risk and issue resolution, facilitates governance and executive reporting, and ensures achievement of the business case objectives, synergies, and strategic outcomes. The role requires strong program management, stakeholder management, change leadership and problem-solving capability in a complex, matrixed environment.

PURPOSE
- The purpose of this position is to lead the refinement and implementation of the overall acquisition integration plan, tracking and driving progress against key milestones

- The Integration Project Manager should be assigned after the Letter of Intent is signed and sustain their leadership until all integration actions are complete

- They will lead, motivate, and guide the Integration Workstream (Functional) Leads to efficiently attain the integration strategy and objectives, collaborating with the acquired leadership team and internal IQVIA stakeholders

- They act as the single point of coordination between AcquiredCo leadership, Corporate Development, the Business Unit sponsors and the Integration Management Office

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Support the transition from Due Diligence to Integration
- Work with Business Unit sponsors and Corporate Development to document the vision and strategic objectives for the integration

- Work with Corporate Development to identify a cross functional team of Integration Workstream Leads across HR, Finance, IT, Commercial, Legal, Quality and Operations

- Work with Corporate Development to plan for known risks discovered in the due diligence phase, including a post-diligence readout with the Legal Lead to review risks to be carried into integration

- Develop and maintain the handover deck documenting the strategy formed by Corporate Development and the Business, bridging the information gap between the diligence and integration teams

Plan, budget, and drive the integration
- Collaborate with key stakeholders to develop and drive a high-level, cross functional integration plan in Smartsheet in support of the overall integration strategy

- Coordinate with all relevant Functions to create a detailed Integration Budget, and work with Finance to monitor the budget and support report outs to key stakeholders

- Implement planning and organization strategies to prioritize tasks, determine required actions, develop timelines and milestones, and leverage resources

- Establish and maintain a governance cadence with Workstream Leads and the executive sponsors, ensuring progress, past-due tasks and risks are visible and actioned

- Manage Smartsheet and the Integration Team Space, ensuring decisions and progress are tracked and reported accurately

- Connect workstreams with dependencies and hold follow-up discussions to verify alignment across the team

- Establish interim ways of working where a functional integration is delayed (e.g., benefits harmonization, finance system implementation) so operations are not disrupted

Support change, culture, and communication
- Facilitate integration team alignment and accelerate change acceptance for both the acquired and IQVIA teams, addressing change resistance through appropriate change management techniques

- Understand the IQVIA and AcquiredCo cultural environments, political and social dynamics, to inform the degree of change expected and the change strategy

- Determine the need to be physically on site at the AcquiredCo and assess whether other functional leads and IQVIA staff should also be on site

- Provide coaching and feedback to AcquiredCo on IQVIA process, approach and decision making

- Support cross-company communication and collaboration between IQVIA and acquired stakeholders to drive awareness and understanding

Resolve complex business problems through the attainment of Steady State
- Identify and manage risks and resolve issues, employing appropriate escalations as needed (e.g., escalation of any legal or compliance related items) throughout the integration process

- Facilitate the integration team’s understanding of root causes to prioritize critical activities that drive productivity and efficiency

- Navigate organizational viewpoints, positioning ideas and actions to push through controversial issues while addressing the concerns of all relevant parties

- Manage the process of strategic and operational integration decision-making, ensuring decisions are made, documented and communicated

- Protect the value of the acquisition by identifying and maintaining the capabilities that made the target attractive in the first place

- Conduct After Action Reviews (AARs) to capture lessons learned and refine the IQVIA integration playbook
- This role requires availability to travel (around 10%)

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY
- Strategic focus

- Planning and organizational skills

- Impactful communication skills

- Ability to build strategic working relationships

- The ability to lead teams effectively and escalate where appropriate

- Experience of leading or facilitating change

- Experience of managing complex, cross-functional projects

- A leadership disposition

- Sound decision making

- The ability to delegate to and empower others

- The ability to navigate politics and manage conflict

- Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority

- Proficiency with project and portfolio tracking tools, in particular Smartsheet

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS
- Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs, ideally within a life sciences, CRO, CDMO or professional services environment

- Prior exposure to M&A, post-merger integration, business transformation or large-scale change programs is strongly preferred

- Working knowledge of the functional disciplines engaged in an integration – HR, Finance, IT, Legal, Commercial, Quality and Operations

- Comfortable operating with ambiguity, incomplete information and competing senior stakeholder priorities

- Willingness and ability to travel and to work on site at the acquired company, particularly during the first six months post-close

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; formal project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is advantageous

MEASURES OF SUCCESS
- Integration milestones delivered to plan, with Steady State attained within the timeframe agreed with the executive sponsors

- Business case objectives and synergies realized and evidenced

- Integration budget managed within approved envelope

- Risks and issues surfaced early and resolved or escalated appropriately, with no material compliance or legal exposure

- Retention of key acquired talent and continuity of client and vendor relationships through the transition

- Accurate, timely reporting to the executive sponsors and the Integration Management Office

This role is not eligible for UK visa sponsorship.

The Medical Director for the Hematology-Oncology Center of Excellence provides strategic medical and scientific subject matter input to IQVIA in this therapeutic area informed by their training, experience and expertise. The activity of the medical director includes but is not necessarily limited to early engagement with potential customers, proposal development in response to RFPs, participation in client proposal bid-defense meetings, support at scientific conferences, participation in thought leadership activities, contribution as needed to the formulation of clinical development plans, providing medical director and subject matter expertise as a consultant throughout the research and development lifecycle and the duration of clinical trials, and engagement with colleagues as an internal reference SME for hematology-oncology. Greater independence is expected to be demonstrated over time for medical director activities under the supervision of the therapeutic area head and leadership team.

Essential Functions
- Work independently under the supervision (direct or indirect) of the Hematology-Oncology Center of Excellence Head and COE Leadership team.
- Provide scientific and clinical advice to internal stakeholders developing proposals, including but not limited to: protocol design/ clinical development plan, insights on mechanism of action of the investigational product, mining data to address important clinical questions relevant to the study, reviewing protocol for scientific/regulatory soundness and feasibility, identification of target site and principle investigator profiles, anticipated patient recruitment, standards of care and competitive landscape.
- Maintain awareness of latest literature to keep abreast of scientific progress in hematology and oncology.
- Participate as needed in the preparation for and conduct of client meetings, such as early engagement, proposal discussion and bid defense meetings, post-award transition and governance meetings, and any other engagements necessary to support the goals and objectives of IQVIA.
- Provide advice, coaching, and preparation of project teams to align executional strategy to medical understanding and considerations.
- Collaborate as appropriate with key stakeholders and leaders in the organization, e.g., Business Development, Operations, Commercial Consulting Services, Real World Services, and other medical strategy leads across the Centres of Excellence
- Act as an internal and external consultant throughout the research and development life cycle and the duration of the clinical trials to provide scientific knowledge and clinical expertise to guide project teams
- Providing scientific knowledge and clinical expertise to guide sponsors in clinical development.

Qualifications
- Oncologist (MD) with training in the relevant therapeutic area . Hematology training or expertise in addition to solid tumor experience is considered a plus.

- Practical knowledge in leading and managing the execution of processes, projects and tactics within research and development.
- Will have had a minimum of 3 years of experience outside of the training period with the biopharmaceutical industry either directly or indirectly.
- Board-certified - Oncology

Professional Skills
- Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, including good command of English language (both written and spoken).
- Innovative and strategic thinker.
- Strong business acumen including confidence with financial considerations, excellent negotiation and influencing skills, and comfort working in scientific, operational, and business development environments.
- Excellent customer relations skills .
- Flexible and able to work in situations where specifications may or may not be well defined and willing to support collaborative work in other therapeutic areas when required.

- Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, managers and clients.
- Maintains a positive outlook at work.
- Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with a wide network of individuals e.g. co-workers, managers and customers.

jobs.title: Director, Clinical FSP Go to Market/Therapeutic Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
Join us on our exciting journey!

IQVIA™ is The Human Data Science Company™, focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics, and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.

Director, Clinical FSP Go to Market/Therapeutic Strategy Lead

The Director, Clinical FSP Go to Market/TSL is the link between key customers and IQVIA, with a primary focus on supporting and leading the design of FSP Solutions and cFSP NNB growth from early engagement, client discussions, to RFI, RFP and bid defense meetings.

He/she is in charge to work closely with Sales, BD, account teams and operations, by providing insights and strategy for customer solutions based on understood requirements across functions.

Responsibilities

- Lead Clinical FSP go-to-market activity by translating IQVIA’s FSP strategy, value proposition and differentiated capabilities into compelling customer-facing positioning, messaging and solution narratives.
- Partner with Sales, Business Development, account teams and CFSP leadership to identify, shape and progress priority FSP opportunities from early engagement through RFI, RFP, proposal development and bid defense.
- Support active and potential sales opportunities by providing FSP subject matter expertise, customer insight, competitive positioning, win themes and practical guidance on the most appropriate FSP, hybrid or flexible delivery model.
- Enable regional Sales and Business Development teams to act as confident FSP ambassadors by creating and maintaining reusable materials, capability decks, battle cards, case studies, solution examples and client-ready messaging.
- Drive structured early engagement with customers through discovery discussions, workshops, capability presentations and proactive account planning, with a focus on expanding the customer base and increasing FSP new business growth.
- Collaborate across CFSP, Operations, Therapeutic Centers of Excellence, Strategic Sites, Technology, Pricing, Talent Acquisition, Marketing and Sales Enablement to build integrated, feasible and differentiated customer solutions.
- Shape FSP solution design best practices to support increasingly complex customer demands, including multi-functional FSPs, blended FSP/FSO models, flexible resourcing constructs, hub-based delivery and technology-enabled solutions.
- Lead or contribute to proposal strategy, response development and review, ensuring the final customer response clearly reflects the client need, IQVIA’s FSP value proposition, operational feasibility, commercial logic and competitive differentiation.
- Develop and refine opportunity-specific narratives, executive summaries, client presentations and bid defense materials that articulate IQVIA’s FSP strengths in a clear, credible and outcome-focused manner.
- Support pricing and commercial strategy discussions by aligning the proposed FSP model, resource assumptions, role mapping, locations and delivery approach with customer expectations and contribution margin requirements.
- Coordinate internal alignment across opportunity teams by clarifying roles, responsibilities, ownership, review timelines, open questions and leadership decisions required to advance high-quality submissions.
- Represent Clinical FSP in customer meetings, internal strategy discussions and bid defenses, presenting the FSP value proposition, solution rationale, flexible delivery options and key differentiators as required.
- Maintain awareness of FSP market trends, customer outsourcing priorities, competitive dynamics, innovation themes and IQVIA capability developments to continuously strengthen the GTM narrative and sales materials.
- Capture lessons learned from opportunities, client discussions and implemented models to improve future FSP positioning, repeatability, scalability and quality of go-to-market execution.
- Support long-term enterprise growth by expanding IQVIA’s FSP services and value, increasing Business Development fluency, strengthening competitive edge and helping the organisation “see more, win more” in Clinical FSP.

Our Ideal Candidate

- 12+ years of clinical research, clinical operations, FSP, outsourcing or drug development experience; equivalent education/training accepted.
- Strong understanding of Clinical FSP delivery models, including functional outsourcing, hybrid FSP/FSO, flexible resourcing, hub-based delivery and multi-functional FSP constructs.
- Commercially minded, with the ability to translate IQVIA capabilities into clear customer value propositions, differentiated messaging and practical solution narratives.
- Experience supporting RFIs, RFPs, proposals, customer presentations, workshops and bid defenses.
- Strong ability to partner with Sales, Business Development, account teams and Operations to shape early engagement, qualify customer needs and progress priority opportunities.
- Confident developing or contributing to sales enablement materials, capability decks, proposal content, case studies, battle cards and reusable client-ready messaging.
- Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align Operations, Pricing, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Marketing and leadership around feasible and competitive customer solutions.
- Solid understanding of clinical trial delivery, drug development, customer outsourcing priorities and key FSP market trends.
- Financial and commercial confidence, including comfort with resource assumptions, pricing logic, contribution margin, role mapping and delivery model trade-offs.
- Excellent communication, presentation and executive storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex operational topics into clear, outcome-focused messages.
- Strong influencing and negotiation skills, with the confidence to manage challenging discussions and drive alignment across matrix teams.
- Technologically confident, with the ability to use data, business intelligence, competitive insights and digital tools to support opportunity strategy and GTM execution.
- Able to work effectively under pressure, manage competing priorities and maintain momentum across multiple opportunities.
- Collaborative, constructive and growth-oriented, with the ability to coach others, share lessons learned and strengthen FSP fluency across the organisation.

Why Join?

You can drive your career at IQVIA and choose the path that best defines your development and success. With exposure across diverse geographies, capabilities, and vast therapeutic and information and technology areas, you can seek opportunities to change and grow without boundaries.

We know that meaningful results require not only the right approach but also the fitting personality . Regardless of your role, we invite you to reimagine healthcare with us. You will have the opportunity to play an important part in helping our clients drive healthcare forward and ultimately improve human health outcomes.

It is an exciting time to join and reimagine what's possible in healthcare.

Moving healthcare forward. Together.

IQVIA is a strong advocate of diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We believe that a work environment that embraces diversity will give us a competitive advantage in the global marketplace and enhance our success. We believe that an inclusive and respectful workplace culture fosters a sense of belonging among our employees, builds a stronger team, and allows individual employees the opportunity to maximize their personal potential.

jobs.title: Analyste financier, FP&A/Financial Analyst, FP&A
jobs.description:
Analyste financier, FP&A/Financial Analyst, FP&A

Analyste financier, FP&A
Objectif du poste :
L’Analyste financier au sein de l’équipe FP&A fournit du soutien analytique et des informations financières aux fonctions dédiées ainsi qu’à l’ensemble de l’organisation. Il assure le contrôle, la coordination et la gestion des données financières pour les rapports de gestion, la planification budgétaire, les prévisions financières et les analyses ponctuelles.

Responsabilités principales :
- Générer et maintenir les rapports de revenus destinés à la direction et aux responsables budgétaires, en assurant l’intégrité des données grâce au rapprochement des chiffres entre les différents systèmes (ERP, CRM, outils de reporting financier).
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de la ligne commerciale pour exécuter le processus mensuel de prévisions de gestion pour les revenus et les dépenses.
- Comparer les revenus et dépenses réels aux prévisions, budgets et périodes précédentes. Identifier et expliquer les écarts, en veillant au respect des principes comptables généralement reconnus (PCGR).
- Contribuer à l’exécution du budget annuel, tant pour les revenus que pour les dépenses.
- Surveiller et rendre compte des risques opérationnels et des opportunités.
- Préparer des analyses budgétaires et de prévisions ainsi que des présentations destinées à la haute direction et aux responsables budgétaires.
- Recommander et mettre en œuvre des solutions système pour les processus de budget et de prévision.
- Effectuer des recherches et produire des rapports pour les demandes d’information et analyses ponctuelles.
- Soutenir et maintenir un processus continu d’évaluation des systèmes et des procédures.
- Intégrer toute fusion/acquisition ou tout nouveau produit dans les flux de travail.

Formation, expérience et connaissances spécialisées requises :
- Baccalauréat en finance ou comptabilité avec 2 à 5 ans d’expérience pertinente en analyse d’affaires, comptabilité ou finance.
- Expérience avec des feuilles de calcul financières, des ensembles de données et des systèmes. Excellente maîtrise de Microsoft Excel exigée. Expérience avec Oracle Hyperion Planning, PowerBI ou Microsoft Access, SAP, SFDC constitue un atout.

Profil recherché :
- Solides compétences analytiques, en résolution de problèmes et en communication.
- Modélisation financière et extraction de données.
- Capacité à comprendre de façon proactive les moteurs financiers et les tendances de performance.
- Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement exigeant avec un fort sens des responsabilités.
- Expérience en préparation de prévisions/budgets.
- Expérience en analyses d’écarts du compte de résultat (P&L) et en explications.
- Bilingue (anglais/français).

Financial Analyst, FP&A
Position Purpose:
The Financial Analyst on the FP&A team provides financial analysis support and insights to dedicated functions and the organization. Provides control, coordination and management of financials for management reporting, budgeting, forecasting and supporting ad-hoc analyses.

Principal Accountabilities:
• Generate and maintain revenue reporting for management and budget holders, ensuring data integrity by reconciling figures across systems (ERP, CRM, financial reporting tools)
• Working closely with the Commercial Business Line leaders, executes the monthly management forecast process for both revenue and expense.
• Compare actual revenue & expense against forecasts, budgets and prior periods. Identify and explain drivers of variances, assisting with compliance to generally accepted accounting principles
• Assist in executing the annual budget exercise, both revenue and expense.
• Monitors and reports on areas of operational risk and opportunity.
• Prepare budget and forecast analysis and presentations for senior management and budget holders.
• Recommends and implements system solutions for the budget and forecast processes.
• Research and reports on ad hoc information requests and analyses.
• Supports and maintains an ongoing process of system and procedure revaluation.
• Integration of any merger & acquisitions or new product offerings into workflows

Minimum Education, Experience, & Specialized Knowledge Required:
• Bachelors degree in Finance or Accounting required with 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in business analysis, accounting and finance.
• Experience in financial spreadsheets, datasets and systems. Strong Microsoft Excel required. Experience with Oracle Hyperion Planning, PowerBI or Microsoft Access, SAP, SFDC is an asset.
Key Profile:
• Strong analytical, problem solving and communication skills
• Financial modeling and data mining
• Proactively seeks to understand financial drivers and business performance trends
• Thrives in a demanding environment with a strong sense of ownership of deliverables
• Experience in preparation of forecasts/budgets
• Experience in preparation of P&L variance analysis and explanations
• Bilingual (English/French)

jobs.title: Director, Business Operations, IQVIA Digital
jobs.location: New York, NY,  United States of America
jobs.description:
About IQVIA Digital
IQVIA Digital powers exceptional brand experiences, delivering innovative solutions based on a customer-first, insights-driven, and integrated omnichannel vision. We provide authenticated, privacy-enhanced data and analytics, innovative fit-for-purpose healthcare technology, and the expertise to enable an effective and adaptable commercial model that drives better quality of care and patient outcomes.

The Strategy & Operations team plays a central role in driving IQVIA Digital’s business performance and client impact. Spanning strategy, account management, delivery, and business operations, the team ensures alignment from go-to-market through execution, partnering closely with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver high-quality outcomes, enable seamless delivery of solutions, and drive operational excellence across the organization.

Role Summary
The Director, Business Operations, is a leadership role responsible for establishing, scaling, and operating a joint RFP and Business Ops function across IQVIA Digital. This is a hands-on commercial leadership position accountable for improving sales execution, deal velocity, and revenue realization across the full commercial lifecycle—from pre-sales proposals, opportunity support and renewals through contracting, pricing, invoicing readiness, and revenue recognition. This role owns the operational infrastructure and processes necessary for Sales success including the dedicated CRM, client project tracking tools, invoicing, collections, and the KPI program execution. Reporting to the VP Strategy & Operations, this role partners closely with Sales, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Operations, Delivery & Execution, Product, and Sales Ops teams to remove administrative and operational friction from the selling process and to ensure consistent, scalable, measurable execution across all IQVIA Digital revenue.

What You’ll Love About This Role
- Lead expansion of existing RFP team beyond its current scope (agency focus) to all IQVIA Digital customer segments (pharma, partner, publisher, etc.) that directly supports revenue acquisition across a complex, multi-product digital portfolio.

- Operate at the intersection of sales strategy and hands-on deal execution.

- Lead coordination of cross-product and inter-business unit pitches

- Partner closely with commercial, finance, legal, and operations leaders to improve speed, accuracy, and predictability of revenue.

- Drive measurable improvements in sales productivity, deal velocity, and in-quarter revenue performance.

- Lead systems, processes, and KPI program integrations that enable and measure commercial and delivery success

Key Responsibilities

RFP Response Coordination
- Lead and scale IQVIA Digital’s centralized RFP capability, building on an established team currently supporting high-volume proposal execution to deliver consistent, high-quality responses across the portfolio.

- Expand the scope of the RFP function beyond its current agency-focused remit into broader client segments (e.g., direct pharma, platforms, data partnerships), ensuring coverage aligns to evolving commercial priorities.

- Own the end-to-end RFP lifecycle including intake, qualification, prioritization, proposal development, cross-functional coordination, and submission, ensuring accountability for timelines, quality, and outcomes.

- Serve as the central coordination point across Sales, Account Management, Product, Delivery, Finance, and Legal to aggregate inputs, align messaging, and drive efficient execution of complex, multi-product proposals.

- Establish standardized RFP processes, templates, and operating rhythms to improve consistency, scalability, and turnaround times while reducing variability across teams and segments.

- Partner with Product Marketing and Product teams to continuously strengthen proposal content, messaging, and positioning to improve win rates and differentiation in competitive situations.

- Develop and maintain a centralized repository of reusable proposal content, case studies, pricing frameworks, and best practices to enable faster and higher-quality responses over time.

- Scale performance tracking across the RFP pipeline (e.g., volume, turnaround time, win rates, contribution to revenue) and use insights to continuously refine strategy, resourcing, and execution.

- Provide surge coverage and leadership during high-priority or complex deals, including coordination of executive inputs and ensuring alignment across senior stakeholders.

Internal Systems & KPI Development
- Lead the development, optimization, and ongoing maintenance of IQVIA Digital’s internal commercial systems in coordination with RBU partners (e.g., Salesforce, Workfront, and related tools), ensuring alignment to enterprise standards while meeting Digital-specific needs.

- Own the design and governance of a centralized KPI framework spanning financial (e.g., revenue visibility, forecasting accuracy), people (e.g., headcount planning, capacity utilization), and process (e.g., workflow efficiency, cycle times) metrics within a single, integrated repository.

- Ensure consistent definitions, data integrity, and cross-functional alignment of KPIs across Sales, Account Management, Delivery, and Finance to enable enterprise-wide transparency and decision-making.

- Develop and operationalize both standard and bespoke KPIs tailored to leadership priorities and functional team needs, ensuring relevance to commercial performance and operational effectiveness.

- Establish regular KPI review cadences with leadership and functional teams to assess performance, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement initiatives tied to measurable impact.

Workflow & Intake Platform Administration (Workfront)
- Own the configuration, administration, and optimization of Workfront to support standardized intake, workflow management, and visibility across commercial and technical operations.

- Design and maintain request queues, intake forms, routing logic, statuses, and automations to ensure work is captured, categorized, and directed to the appropriate owning teams.

- Configure incidents and request intake of workflows to support triage by delivery and technical teams, without assuming responsibility for resolution or execution.

- Partner with Sales, Account Management, Technical Operations, and Project Delivery teams to translate operational requirements into scalable Workfront configurations.

- Maintain platform governance, including naming conventions, workflow standards, permissions, and change controls.

Contracting, Pricing & Invoicing Enablement
- Act as IQVIA Digital point-of-contact to lead standardization of contracting workflows, including creating GTM intake standards for Statements of Work (SOWs) creation and improving execution with RBU Legal and Contracting.

- Support pricing accuracy by coordinating pricing models, managing discount documentation, and coordinating required approvals with Product and Finance.

- Ensure invoicing readiness from PO setup coordination with account teams to post-sale handoff to billing teams.

- Partner with Finance and Account Management to resolve invoicing, billing, and revenue recognition issues that impact cash flow or client experience.

Functional Leadership & Team Development
- Build, structure, and lead a joint RFP and BPTO team aligned to IQVIA Digital commercial and operational priorities.

- Set clear objectives, operating rhythms, and performance expectations for the function.

- Coach and develop managers and individual contributors, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.

- Identify opportunities to redeploy seller capacity by shifting administrative and execution work into the enablement function.

Cross-Functional Partnership
- Partner with GTM, Strategy, and Marketing to deliver high quality RFP submissions

- Partner with Account Management leadership to support revenue growth, retention, and expansion.

- Collaborate with Product Marketing and Product teams to ensure sales readiness and consistent messaging.

- Work closely with Sales Operations, Finance, and Legal to streamline forecasting, pricing, contracting, and approval processes.

- Identify opportunities for IQVIA Digital growth within accounts through the creation, publication, and monitoring of impactful KPIs.

jobs.description:
Overview
- Services rendered will adhere to applicable Sponsor SOPs, WIs, policies, codes of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), local regulatory requirements, etc., while serving as a subject matter expert and resource for quality and compliance standards across assigned studies.

- Complies with relevant training requirements and maintains advanced therapeutic, operational, and regulatory knowledge applicable to assigned programs.

- Leads and contributes to quality Site Selection through participation in site feasibility ensuring consistent conduct of site qualification visits and appropriate follow-up of site qualification visit reports and country feasibility reports. Collaborates with central study teams and local stakeholders as applicable for final selection of sites to participate in trials and provides strategic recommendations for site selection and performance optimization.

- Ensures local/country team is meeting recruitment targets with high quality data on time and within study budget by providing strategic input to study-level documents and independently leading/coordinating local team activities in compliance with SOPs, other procedural documents, and applicable regulations. This may require development of local trial-specific procedures and tools, recruitment planning, contingency and risk management, budget forecasting, and mitigation strategies for complex studies.

- Acts as primary Sponsor contact for assigned trial at the country level and serves as the local operational lead for complex studies. May attend/participate in Investigator Meetings as needed and may schedule and conduct local/country investigator meetings.

- Drives study compliance by maintaining and updating trial management systems, using study tools and management reports available to analyze trial progress. Independently identifies risks, trends, and issues and proactively initiates corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) when studies deviate from plans. Communicates study progress, risks, mitigation strategies, and key operational insights to study management teams and Quality & Compliance teams.

- Leads development and execution of country-level recruitment strategies and contingency planning in partnership with other functional areas to achieve clinical research targets and improve site performance.

- Delivers advanced vendor management at the country level to support the study and may submit requests for vendor services and support vendor selection. This includes oversight of vendor performance, issue resolution, budget management, review and approval of site and local vendor invoices as required. As required, manages local study supplies.

- Ensures high standards for study monitoring by leading quality local trial team meetings and facilitating Site Manager training when needed (i.e., implementation of study amendments and changes in study-related processes).

- Contributes to patient understanding of protocol and patient safety by preparing country-specific informed consent documents in accordance with procedural document/templates. This includes reviewing and managing site-specific informed consent forms in accordance with SOPs, other procedural documents, and applicable regulations.

- Ensures trial subject safety in that all AEs/SAEs/PQCs are reported within required reporting timelines and documented appropriately. Proactively identifies and escalates potential patient safety concerns.

- Ensures Inspection Readiness by maintaining complete, accurate, and timely data and essential documents in systems utilized for trial management (e.g., CTMS and eTMF/IF) according to expectations (metrics) and archiving retention requirements. Proactively identifies quality trends, compliance risks, and documentation gaps across projects and drives resolution activities. Escalates significant issues to the TDM/TDL and Sponsor in a timely manner.

- Accountable for ensuring quality data (accurate, valid, and complete) is provided by the site and that queries are resolved within expected timelines. Provides oversight and guidance to improve site data quality and operational performance.

- Keeps oneself inspection ready and knowledgeable for current work by complying with relevant training requirements and maintaining advanced therapeutic area, protocol, operational, and regulatory knowledge.

- With focus on quality and compliance, works closely with Site Managers to ensure CAPAs are implemented for audits/inspections or any quality-related visits. May conduct accompanied site visits with Site Managers, if delegated by the Sponsor, and may provide coaching on quality-related findings and trends.

- Ensures accurate finance reporting and trial delivery within budget by adhering to finance reporting deliverables and timelines. This includes advanced forecasting and proactive management of country/local trial budgets, identification of financial risks, and implementation of mitigation plans. If applicable, may support negotiation of trial site contracts and budgets.

- Keeps the trial in compliance with local regulatory requirements by organizing and ensuring IEC/HA approvals in cooperation with the local Start-Up team, as applicable. Provides guidance on complex regulatory considerations and country-specific requirements.

- Serves as a trainer, mentor, and subject matter expert for systems/processes and local trial management practices. Provides coaching and support to less experienced team members and contributes to onboarding and capability development activities.

- Leads and contributes to functional area initiatives, process improvement activities, inspection readiness activities, operational excellence projects, and implementation of new systems and processes.

- Full utilization by timely and accurate time reporting.

- Demonstrates experience in management and startup of complex Early Phase trials and projects involving matrix clinical teams, external partners, and investigational sites, as applicable.

- Leads country-level operational planning and execution for complex, high-priority, or high-risk studies requiring advanced trial management expertise and independent decision-making.

- If applicable, region-specific deliverables will be specified.

Education and Experience Requirements:

jobs.title: Change Management & Analytics Lead
jobs.description:
Location : EMEA (Madrid, Barcelona, Lisbon, Greece)

Position Overview
The Change Management and Analytics Lead will join the Enterprise Pricing program within Corporate Finance. The scope of this program is to provide pricing guidance to offering leadership, go-to-market (GTM) teams, and staff responsible for quote development across all business units.
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic professional to serve as Change Management and Analytics Lead for the organization-wide deployment of a new pricing/quoting system (CPQ: Configure Price Quote). This role will be integral in the migration from legacy pricing methodologies to a unified, digital platform across all business units. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of operational leadership, change management expertise, and advanced analytical skills to drive both adoption and continuous improvement.
This role offers a distinctive opportunity to lead transformative changes while leveraging data-driven insights to shape the future of pricing within the organization. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are passionate about operational excellence and analytics, this is your team!

Key Responsibilities
Change Management: User Engagement & System Deployment
This portion of the role entails facilitating the transition of offerings and their associated users into the new CPQ system. This person will be the primary liaison between the offerings and the technical team responsible for configuring the system.
Lead System Deployment Change Management and Stakeholder Engagement :
- Spearhead the transition of all IQVIA offerings from decentralized pricing processes to a centralized new system
- Develop and execute change management strategies to drive adoption at scale. This includes tasks such as facilitating meetings with different types of audiences, consolidating and developing key messages for communication, track progress on defined tasks, follow-up on go-live activities, etc.
- Liaise with key stakeholders to ensure alignment regarding deployment roadmap and facilitate smooth migration. This includes tasks such as collecting business feedback, cascading information to technical teams, participating in internal calls to voice and address business concerns, and summarizing tasks expected from business to manage expectations in a concise manner

Process Optimization : Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current operational activities to  recommend and implement improvements for streamlining deployment activities.
Performance Tracking : Monitor and report on the progress of transition efforts, providing actionable feedback to accelerate adoption and resolve roadblocks.
Analytics: Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
This portion of the role entails tracking and analyzing pricing performance of offerings and proactively proposing areas of improvement in any reporting area: data collection mechanisms, definition of new metrics, refinement of methodologies, proposal of actionable insights, feedback traceability…
Offering Performance Monitoring :
- Coordinate with management to design and implement a performance monitoring program
- In conjunction with centralized reporting teams, develop and maintain dashboards to establish mechanisms to enable effective tracking of offerings price performance
- Liaise with key business stakeholders to identify baseline requirements as well as areas of improvement and integrate feedback via our Technical and/or our Pricing Advisor team

Actionable Insights :
- Propose benchmarks for pricing effectiveness and automated alert systems to proactively flag deviations and risks
- Analyze data to generate insights that inform strategic decisions, recommending and aligning with Pricing Advisors adjustments to pricing strategies to maximize business impact
- Support the design and implementation of AI capabilities that will guide and influence pricing activities within the CPQ system based on the team’s analytical frameworks

Bug Identification & Resolution : identify defects and system issues, collaborating with technical teams to prioritize fixes and propose enhancements
Continuous Improvement :
- Collect enhancement proposals through two main channels in an iterative manner: Reactive: Establish feedback loops with users and stakeholders and provide mechanisms to collect their proposals
Proactive: Team sourced findings derived from reporting analysis via recurring analysis (i.e.: new metrics, refined visualizations, additional supporting capabilities, etc.)

- Liaise with the technical teams to deploy proposed enhancements: communicate backlog of changes, align on priorities, ensure technical requirements are aligned with reporting goals and follow-up on deployment progress
- Conduct internal testing of enhancements and facilitate User Acceptance Testing with selected stakeholders

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
- Proven experience in Program Operations, stakeholder management, large-scale change management projects, systems deployment, and business analytics (data management)
- Knowledge of price development, deal structures, and/or commercial operations
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in a professional business setting
- Ability to present data to management in a concise and simplified manner
- Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau)
- Knowledge of AI tools (e.g., Copilot or ChatGPT) and automation tools (e.g., Power Automate) to drive processes automation
- Knowledge of or able to transition from a descriptive reporting capability to a prescriptive analytics capability
- Trained in Lean practices (nice to have)
- Ability to work collaboratively and independently in cross-functional teams and adapt to evolving priorities in highly ambiguous environments
- Willing to “fail fast” and learn from mistakes while celebrating our successes
- Ability to work simultaneously on multiple priorities, projects, and tasks
- Organized and detail-oriented in how you manage work and present deliverables
- Ability to apply project management techniques to maintain accountability for self and monitor accountability for others’ contributions to your work
- Proficiency in English, both spoken and written is a must

Education and Experience
- 5+ years of professional work experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management Information Systems, Finance, Economics, Data Science or related field. MBA preferred
- Experience deploying at least two systems to a large group of diverse stakeholders in a global enterprise
- Experience in managing and analyzing large data sets, and presenting results in a concise and insightful manner
- A minimum of 2 years of experience in a consulting role or in a cross-functional role

jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Senior HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a mature, dynamic, proactive, and solutions-driven professional who plays a critical role in aligning HR strategies with business unit goals. This role bridges the global HR agenda with local business needs within the specified business unit, providing expert guidance to managers and employees, and ensuring the delivery of high-impact HR solutions. As a key driver of transformation, the HRBP will lead initiatives to enhance efficiency, standardize processes, and deliver first-class HR services across our teams in Africa.
This role requires exceptional interpersonal skills and collaborative approach, strong project management capabilities, and a results-oriented mindset. Working within a complex, matrixed global organization, the HRBP will, together with other team members, lead local and regional HR initiatives, manage projects with precision, and serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders.
Success in this role requires the ability to take charge, drive implementation, and foster strong relationships at all levels of the organization.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic HR Partnership
- Partner with business leaders to develop and execute HR initiatives that combine global HR strategies with local business priorities.

- Actively participate in key people-related decisions, anticipating challenges and addressing people issues proactively.

- Provide HR knowledge and strategic advice to support the execution of business projects and organizational initiatives.

- Provide hands-on support to managers on key people processes, including performance management, team development, change management and resource planning.

- Handle complex HR data reporting, leveraging advanced Excel skills and an analytical mindset to deliver actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making.

HR Efficiency, Transformation, and Policy Alignment
- Lead and implement projects that drive HR efficiency, transformation, and process standardization across the businesses in Africa.

- Ensure HR services, policies, and systems are practical, relevant, and aligned with business needs and compliance requirements in African countries.

- Work collaboratively with HR colleagues to develop and refine policies and introduce innovative ways of working.

- Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence (CoEs) and Shared Service Centers on projects.

EOR Service Delivery, Compliance, and Operational Excellence (Africa)
- Lead and oversee end-to-end Employer of Record (EOR) service delivery across Africa, ensuring seamless onboarding, lifecycle management, and offboarding of contractors.

- Ensure full compliance with local labour laws, tax regulations, and statutory requirements across all operating countries, mitigating legal and financial risk.

- Drive standardisation, efficiency, and continuous improvement of EOR processes, enhancing service quality, turnaround times, and client satisfaction.

- Collaborate with business stakeholders, HR teams, and external partners to optimise delivery models and ensure alignment to commercial objectives and client needs.

- Work closely with HR Centres of Excellence (CoEs), Payroll, Legal, and Shared Services to strengthen governance, reporting, and operational exellence.

Performance and Capability Development
- Provide strategic coaching and advice to managers on organizational effectiveness, team dynamics, and leadership development.

- Advise, challenge, and coach Business Managers on people-related processes, including performance management, team and personal development, career path planning, resource planning, and restructuring needs.

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
This role involves development and execution of brand strategies, , engaging with stakeholders and HCPs, overseeing marketing campaigns, and conducting brand and market analytics. The Marketing Manager will ensure the brand performance aligns with business goals and market dynamics. This is a strategic and customer- facing role, requiring close collaboration across departments to enhance the brand presence in the market.

Responsibilities

Brand Strategy and Execution

•Take responsibility for managing the day-to-day activities related to brand performance, ensuring alignment with business goals.
•Collaborate with cross-functional teams (sales, medical, regulatory and market access) to ensure consistent brand messaging across all platforms.
•Monitor and evaluate brand performance using KPIs and provide recommendations for brand optimization.

Customer and Healthcare Provider Engagement

•Engage with external stakeholders including HCPs and hospital administrators to promote the brand and gather market insights.
•Build and maintain relationships with HCPs to ensure alignment of marketing strategies with market needs.
•Leverage feedback from HCPs to improve brand positioning and marketing strategies.
•Assist in the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns that align with the brand’s strategy and objectives.
•Develop and implement marketing tactics across multiple channels, including digital, print, and events, to drive brand awareness and product adoption.
•Coordinate with external agencies and vendors to ensure that campaigns are executed effectively and within budget.
•Monitor and track campaign performance, using analytics to measure success and optimize future marketing activities.
•Collaborate with sales team to ensure integration of CRM data into marketing strategies, improving engagement and customer segmentation.
•Develop omnichannel marketing strategies to reach HCPs through variety of channels including email, webinar, face-to-face and digital content.
•Analyze and report on the performance of omnichannel campaigns using CRM analytics to optimize and enhance customer engagement.

Market Analytics
•Conduct brand and market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for growth.
•Analyze data from customer feedback, sales reports, and market research to assess the brand’s performance and competitive positioning.
•Prepare detailed reports on brand performance, market trends, and competitor activities to support decision-making of the brand
•Provide actionable insights from market analysis to help guide future brand strategies and campaigns.

Product Launches and Lifecycle Management
•Assist in the planning and execution of product launches, ensuring alignment with overall brand strategy.
•Work with internal teams to ensure that all aspects of product positioning, messaging, and marketing communications are consistent and compliant with regulatory guidelines.

Event and Conference Management
•Support the planning and execution of events, including conferences, workshops, and product presentations.
•Work with marketing admin to manage the logistics of events, including venue booking, speaker coordination, and promotional material distribution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
•Collaborate with internal teams, including sales, medical, regulatory and market access to ensure seamless execution of brand strategies.
•Coordinate with sales teams to ensure that brand campaigns are aligned with sales objectives and product positioning.
•Work closely with the regulatory team to ensure all marketing materials and promotional activities comply with industry regulations.

Budget Management
•Managing the marketing budget for the brand, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively.
•Track and report on expenses related to marketing campaigns, events, and promotional activities, ensuring adherence to budget guidelines.

Qualifications
•Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Medical Biosciense, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or related field.

Experience :
•3-5 years of experience in sales, marketing, brand management, or related roles in the pharmaceutical industry
•Experience working with healthcare professionals and managing customer relationships.
•Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, including regulatory requirements and market dynamics.

Skills
•Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed marketing decisions.
•Proficiency in digital marketing tools, CRM systems, and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
•Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with healthcare professionals and cross-functional teams.
