jobs.location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States of America
jobs.description:
Director, Strategic Business Development – IQVIA Language Solutions
Europe-based | Business Development | Life Sciences & Healthcare
The opportunity
IQVIA Language Solutions is building the multilingual operating layer for global life sciences—bringing together healthcare intelligence, AI-enabled workflows, specialist human expertise and the reach of IQVIA. We are moving beyond traditional translation to help customers manage critical content safely and efficiently across clinical, regulatory, safety, patient and commercial workflows.
Join a growing, entrepreneurial commercial team and help shape the next generation of language solutions for healthcare. With IQVIA’s credibility and scientific expertise behind you, you will have the freedom to open new relationships and create solutions that traditional language providers cannot easily replicate.
As Director, Strategic Business Development, you will be a senior individual contributor and visible growth leader. You will own net-new business across an assigned EMEA market or account portfolio, lead complex pursuits through close, and position IQVIA Language Solutions as a strategic partner delivering faster global execution, lower workflow friction and stronger quality and compliance.

What you will do
- Own and exceed an annual net-new bookings and revenue target across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO and healthcare customers.
- Build and manage a high-quality pipeline through strategic prospecting, networks, events and collaboration across IQVIA, supported by focused territory and target-account plans.
- Lead consultative discovery with senior stakeholders and translate customer challenges into differentiated solutions across clinical, regulatory, safety, patient, medical and commercial workflows.
- Position AI-enabled, human-assured and expert-led delivery models according to content risk, required assurance and customer outcomes.
- Own the full sales cycle—from qualification and opportunity strategy through proposal, negotiation, contracting and handover—including strategic RFI, RFP and proposal-defense activity.
- Build executive relationships and influence complex buying committees by clearly articulating IQVIA’s value in workflow integration, scientific expertise, quality, compliance and speed.
- Partner across Presales, Account Management, Delivery, Technology, Quality, Finance, Pricing, Legal and Marketing to create commercially sound, operationally viable solutions.
- Create both standalone Language Solutions opportunities and integrated pursuits within broader IQVIA offerings, while bringing market insight back to offering and technology teams.
- Maintain accurate CRM records and forecasts, and represent IQVIA Language Solutions through relevant events, campaigns and thought leadership.

What success looks like
- A healthy, qualified pipeline that converts into new logos, new buying centers and larger strategic opportunities.
- Consistent quota achievement, strong win rates and reliable forecasts supported by disciplined opportunity management.
- Executive-level relationships and more integrated IQVIA opportunities that demonstrate measurable customer impact beyond translation fulfillment.

What you bring
- Proven success in enterprise business development or strategic sales, with consistent achievement of net-new revenue targets.
- Strong experience selling to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO or healthcare organizations.
- Localization, multilingual content or regulated-content experience is strongly preferred; adjacent life sciences technology or professional services experience will also be considered.
- Demonstrated ability to open new accounts and buying centers and progress complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities from discovery through close.
- Fluency in consultative, value-based selling and the credibility to influence senior and executive stakeholders.
- Commercial acumen across proposals, pricing, negotiation, contracts, competitive positioning and forecast management.
- Curiosity about AI and localization technology, with the judgment to balance automation, human expertise, quality, security and compliance.
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative, resilient approach suited to a fast-evolving environment; ability to travel within Europe and internationally as needed.

Why join IQVIA Language Solutions?
You will join at a pivotal point: the team is scaling its commercial organization, broadening into new life sciences workflows and building a more connected, technology-enabled portfolio. This role offers the chance to win meaningful business today while helping define how IQVIA brings multilingual intelligence, governance and human expertise into the healthcare workflows of tomorrow. If you are energized by creating markets, challenging the traditional localization model and building something with global reach, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Therapeutic Strategy Lead  - IMM - (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description:
Join Our Team as a Therapeutic Strategy Lead!
Are you passionate about creating innovative delivery strategies that meet customer needs? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where you can make a real impact? If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!

Purpose
As a Therapeutic Strategy Lead, you’ll develop and implement effective delivery strategies tailored to customer needs during the RFP/Bid Defense cycle. You’ll bridge the gap between sales, medical, and operational teams to ensure seamless project execution and support sales teams throughout the Business Development process.

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Actively collaborate with Sales, Medical, Operations, and other functions and provide guidance to ensure tailor-made strategies to project or programs that differentiate IQVIA from the competition resulting in compelling, feasible proposals and continuously drive business growth.
- Scan the therapeutic and operational landscape and take account of wider impacts to develop long term implementation strategies that maximize opportunities to add value.
- Maintain an understanding of current and future market trends that may impact current and/or future innovative operational delivery strategies.
- Act as champion for project centricity within the organization through enabling the project delivery team assigned to an awarded project to understand and implement the project strategy that was sold.
- Drive the team to leverage and consolidate all available data to build the project strategy. Balance use of external research and data with IQVIA’s internal data sources.
- Guide and mentor assigned Project Leader so that they can confidently present the project strategy to the client and the internal stakeholders.
- Actively support Sales in the preparation and conduct of customer and bid defense meetings e.g. training and preparation of the assigned project team.
- Attend, present and lead or bid defense meeting or customer meeting, as required
- Identify any quality issues within the study and provide coaching on resolution of issues, including implementation of corrective and preventative action plans and escalation.
- Ensure project/program budget(s) meet financial and company goals, including Gross New Business.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
- Deep and current knowledge of the scientific, clinical operations, real world, regulatory, operational, commercial and competitive landscape in applicable therapeutic area.
- ·Strong global knowledge and awareness/understanding of the biopharma industry, drug development lifecycle and operational clinical trial delivery.
- In-depth knowledge of applicable clinical research regulatory requirements; e.g. Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
- Strong business acumen including confidence with financial considerations, excellent negotiation and influencing skills, and comfort working in both sales and operational environments.
- Strong customer management skills and demonstrated ability to understand customer needs, have difficult conversations with internal/external stakeholders and customers, negotiate solutions and understand impacts on the overall program/portfolio.
- Strong leadership skills, ability to lead a virtual team in a matrix organization.
- Ability to work strategically to realize organizational and project goals, identifying and developing positive and compelling visions for the successful delivery of projects and taking account of a wide range of issues across, and related to, the projects and the organization.
- Strong presentation skills.
- Excellent written, verbal communication and interpersonal skills, including good command of English language (both written and spoken).
- Proficiency in Mandarin language
- Strong software and computer skills, including MS Office applications.
- Must have prior experience in the Clinical Research Organization (CRO) industry

MINIMUM REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
- Bachelor's degree in life sciences and relevant global clinical research experience (director level), including hands on operational delivery and/or drug development experience in the applicable therapeutic area (IMM )

jobs.title: Pharmacy Partnership Manager
jobs.description:
Pharmacy Partnership Manager
Patient Care & Education

Farmaceutisch field project | Projectcontract tot eind 2027

Heb je ervaring in de farmaceutische wereld en wil je jouw terreinervaring een nieuwe dimensie geven?

Voor een nieuw farmaceutisch project rond de begeleiding van apotheken en de verbetering van het patiëntentraject binnen obesitas zoeken we een ervaren professional met een sterke affiniteit met de apotheekwereld.
Deze functie staat nadrukkelijk open voor farmaceutisch afgevaardigden die willen evolueren naar een meer sell-outgerichte aanpak , waarbij advies, educatie, coaching en de kwaliteit van de relatie met de apotheker centraal staan.
Dit is geen klassieke functie die uitsluitend draait om productpromotie of een hoog aantal bezoeken. Jouw missie: een echte partner worden voor de apotheker.
Jouw rol
Binnen jouw regio bouw je duurzame vertrouwensrelaties op met de apotheken in jouw portefeuille. Je ondersteunt apotheekteams zodat zij hun rol in de begeleiding van mensen met overgewicht of obesitas verder kunnen versterken.
- Sterke partnerships uitbouwen met apothekers en apotheekteams.

- Apotheekteams sensibiliseren rond obesitas als chronische aandoening en de stigma’s die ermee gepaard kunnen gaan.

- Apothekers ondersteunen om dit gevoelige onderwerp op een gepaste, respectvolle en professionele manier bespreekbaar te maken.

- Apotheekteams coachen zodat zij relevante gesprekken met hun patiënten kunnen voeren.

- De rol van de apotheek in patiëntenvoorlichting, begeleiding en opvolging helpen versterken.

- Bijdragen aan de continuïteit van het behandeltraject en therapietrouw.

- Wetenschappelijke en educatieve informatie helder, toegankelijk en engagerend overbrengen.

- Goedgekeurde materialen en tools ter beschikking stellen om patiëntbegeleiding te ondersteunen.

- Jouw apotheekportefeuille zelfstandig en proactief beheren en ontwikkelen.

- Relevante behoeften en inzichten uit het werkveld delen met het projectteam.

- Steeds handelen volgens de ethische en compliance-richtlijnen van de farmaceutische sector.

Een andere manier van werken op het terrein
Succes draait in deze functie niet uitsluitend om het aantal bezoeken. De nadruk ligt op de kwaliteit van jouw gesprekken, diepgaande interacties en het opbouwen van duurzame partnerships met apothekers.
Partnership + sell-out + educatie + coaching + impact op patiëntenzorg
Stap je gemakkelijk een apotheek binnen en leg je spontaan contact? Kan je goed luisteren naar de behoeften van een apotheker en vervolgens adviseren, coachen en uitdagen? Wil je graag verder gaan dan een traditionele commerciële aanpak? Dan zou deze functie bij jou kunnen passen.
Jouw profiel
Professionele ervaring binnen de farmaceutische sector of farmaceutische omgeving is noodzakelijk.
Jouw achtergrond kan bijvoorbeeld aansluiten bij een functie als:
- Farmaceutisch afgevaardigde die wil evolueren naar een meer adviserende en sell-outgerichte aanpak.

- Ervaren professional uit de apotheekwereld met een goed inzicht in de behoeften van apothekers.

- Apotheker die de stap naar een field-based partnershipfunctie wil zetten.

- Trainer of coach met relevante ervaring binnen apotheken.

- Professional uit de dermocosmetica met ruime ervaring binnen het apotheekkanaal en het vermogen om inhoud kwalitatief over te brengen.

Jouw troeven
- Goede kennis van het farmaceutische landschap en de apotheekwereld.

- Zelfstandigheid, proactiviteit, verantwoordelijkheidszin en een ondernemende mindset.

- Assertiviteit en het vertrouwen om nieuwe contacten te leggen op het terrein.

- Sterke vaardigheden in communicatie, actief luisteren en coaching.

- Het vermogen om wetenschappelijke informatie snel te begrijpen en helder over te brengen.

- Het vermogen om gevoelige onderwerpen respectvol, empathisch en professioneel te bespreken.

- Sterke organisatievaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheid voor de ontwikkeling van jouw regio.

- Vloeiend Nederlands en een goede professionele kennis van het Engels.

- Een geldig rijbewijs en bereidheid om hoofdzakelijk op het terrein te werken.

Een wetenschappelijke opleiding is een pluspunt, maar geen absolute vereiste. Vooral jouw vermogen om wetenschappelijke informatie te begrijpen en op een duidelijke en relevante manier over te brengen is doorslaggevend.
Waarom deelnemen aan dit project?
- Meewerken aan een betekenisvol nieuw farmaceutisch project dat loopt tot eind 2027.

- Relatieopbouw, expertise, coaching, autonomie en terreinwerk combineren.

- Echte partnerships met apotheekteams uitbouwen.

- De rol van de apotheker binnen het zorgtraject rond obesitas helpen versterken.

- Een opleiding volgen om jouw wetenschappelijke kennis en patiëntgerichte aanpak verder te ontwikkelen.

Klaar om jouw farmaceutische ervaring een nieuwe richting te geven?
Wil je evolueren van een voornamelijk promotionele aanpak naar een functie waarin partnership, sell-out, educatie en begeleiding meer centraal staan? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou.
Solliciteer en word een echte partner voor apotheekteams.

Business Development Director - Tech Enabled Sales Organization (TESO), Large & Mid-Sized Pharma

Job Overview
Lead business development efforts across an assigned portfolio of Large and Mid-Sized Pharmaceutical accounts, driving account growth, opportunity expansion, and new business acquisition. Develop opportunities across IQVIA's Tech Enabled Sales Organization (TESO), partnering with clients to address evolving business challenges through innovative outsourced engagement solutions, technology-enabled capabilities, and AI-enhanced approaches that improve customer engagement and business outcomes.

This role is responsible for expanding IQVIA's presence within strategically important pharmaceutical accounts by creating new opportunities, shaping client solutions, and advancing business through award and implementation.

Why IQVIA
IQVIA is a global leader in healthcare intelligence and commercialization solutions, partnering with pharmaceutical and life sciences organizations to solve complex business challenges. Through its Tech Enabled Sales Organization (TESO), IQVIA brings together deep industry expertise, operational scale, industry-leading healthcare data assets , innovative technology, and emerging AI-enabled approaches to help clients evolve customer engagement and accelerate business performance.

This role offers the opportunity to connect those strengths to meaningful client needs and help shape the next generation of outsourced engagement solutions.

Essential Functions

Business Development & Opportunity Creation
- Proactively identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities within assigned Large and Mid-Sized Pharmaceutical accounts.
- Develop opportunities that may not yet be formally defined or part of an active procurement process, shaping client needs into actionable business opportunities.
- Execute account growth and penetration strategies to expand relationships, uncover new opportunities, and increase IQVIA's presence within assigned accounts.
- Maintain a robust pipeline through strategic outreach, networking, lead generation, and consistent client engagement.
- Monitor market trends, client needs, and competitive activity to identify emerging opportunities and inform business development strategies.

Strategic Account Growth
- Build and expand relationships with key decision-makers and influencers across assigned accounts.
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key client stakeholders to identify needs, uncover opportunities, and position IQVIA as a trusted partner.
- Develop and execute account plans aligned to client priorities and IQVIA growth objectives.
- Maintain a deep understanding of client organizations, business challenges, and evolving engagement needs.
- Apply insight from client interactions to strengthen account strategy, expand relationships, and identify new areas of opportunity.

Client Solutions & Opportunity Development
- Partner with internal stakeholders to develop innovative, client-focused solutions that address strategic business needs.
- Translate client challenges, strategic priorities, and operational needs into customized solutions that leverage the breadth of IQVIA's capabilities.
- Lead and coordinate proposal development efforts, partnering with internal stakeholders to develop compelling, differentiated solutions that align with client objectives and business needs.

jobs.description:

Deine Aufgaben

- Teilnahme an und Durchführung von Kundenterminen mit Krankenkassen, Kassenärztlichen Vereinigungen und Krankenhäusern sowie Übersetzung von Kundenanforderungen und Erkenntnissen aus internen Austauschen in Initiativen zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Lösungen, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Produktmanagement und Entwicklung
- Identifikation und Bewertung neuer Geschäftspotenziale in den Segmenten Abrechnungs- und Genehmigungsmanagement, Softwarelösungen sowie Digitalisierung und Archivierung, auf Basis von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und regulatorischen Entwicklungen in der GKV sowie in der ambulanten und stationären Versorgung

- Fähigkeit im Team zu arbeiten sowie eine eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Affinität zur Nutzung von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Arbeitsalltag wünschenswert
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen. Das erwartet Dich:
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Gleitzeitmodell und hybrid (remote und im Office), full remote / anlassbezogen im Büro
- Faire Überstundenregelung mit Freizeitausgleich oder einer Vergütungsmöglichkeit mit 25% Überstundenzuschlag
- Mentoren-Programm während deiner gesamten Einarbeitungszeit

- Interne Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des IQVIA Konzerns
- Individuelle Weiterbildungen, unternehmensinterne Workshops, Teilnahme an Fachkonferenzen möglich

- Kostenlose Kalt- und Heißgetränke und kostenfreies Obst

- Rabatte im Partner-Reisebüro
